explication: BEHAVIOR-1K is an embodied-AI simulation benchmark for household activities. Its central user workflow is an agent interacting with a simulated environment and being assessed on task outcomes. The tree also shows task-language semantics, evaluation and data interfaces, and a substantial asset pipeline. The README establishes the benchmark scope; most implementation excerpts are partial or unrelated, so uncertain runtime wiring is omitted.
